nodes.description: Constructor that mints the entire _tTotal supply to the deployer (_msgSender) and emits Transfer.
Internal transfer routine: validates addresses, enforces blacklist/bot max amount, then mutates _balances with SafeMath sub/add.
Public ERC20 transfer that forwards _msgSender as sender into _transfer.
Public ERC20 transferFrom: performs _transfer then deducts the caller allowance via SafeMath sub.
Public approval entry point delegating to _approve with _msgSender as owner.
Private allowance writer validating non-zero owner/spender and storing _allowances[owner][spender].
Owner-only setter that stores the blacklist bot address in _tBotAddress.
Owner-only setter that stores the blacklist address in _tBlackAddress.
Owner-only mint function that increases _tTotal and credits _msgSender balance with arbitrary amount.
Owner-only setter computing _maxBlack with a raw unchecked multiplication (maxTxBlackPercent * 10**18).
View returning the stored allowance for owner/spender.
View returning the _balances entry for an account.
View returning the mutable _tTotal supply.
View returning the token name string.
View returning the token symbol string.
View returning token decimals.
Ownership getter that is intentionally stubbed to return address(0).
Owner-only function that emits OwnershipTransferred but never clears _owner.
Owner-only ownership transfer validating newOwner != 0 and writing _owner.
Modifier enforcing _owner == _msgSender() on privileged functions.
Internal helper returning msg.sender as address payable.
Private mapping of holder address to token balance; mutated by _transfer and setFeeTotal.
Private nested mapping of owner to spender to allowed amount.
Public address used as the bot recipient trigger for the blacklist max-amount check.
Public address excluded from the blacklist max-amount restriction.
Private mutable total supply, initially 100e9 * 1e18.
Public threshold for transfers toward _tBotAddress.
Private owner address set in the constructor and by transferOwnership.
Externally controlled caller address used for authorization, transfers and minting credits.
Debit of the sender balance inside _transfer using SafeMath sub.
Credit of the recipient balance inside _transfer using SafeMath add.
Allowance deduction in transferFrom, keyed by the untrusted caller.
Uncapped supply increase in setFeeTotal, allowing arbitrary owner minting.
Owner balance credit in setFeeTotal, coupled with the supply increase.
Raw unchecked multiplication in setMaxTxBlack that can silently overflow.
Direct allowance storage write in _approve without resetting to zero first.
Sender address argument of _transfer/transferFrom.
Recipient address argument of transfer/_transfer.
Amount argument moved in _transfer.
Spender argument of approve/_approve.
Owner argument of _approve.
New bot address argument of setBlackListBot.
New blacklist address argument of setBlackAddress.
Multiplier argument of setMaxTxBlack used in the raw multiplication.
New owner argument of transferOwnership.
Account argument of balanceOf.
Mint amount argument of setFeeTotal.
Constructor local caching _msgSender() before assigning _owner.

edges.reason: transfer() invokes the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom() invokes the internal _transfer routine before the allowance deduction.
transferFrom() deducts the caller allowance after moving tokens.
approve() delegates to the private _approve writer.
_approve() writes the allowance state slot.
_transfer() debits the sender balance.
_transfer() credits the recipient balance.
setFeeTotal() inflates the total supply.
setFeeTotal() credits the owner balance.
setMaxTxBlack() performs an unchecked multiplication that can overflow to a small threshold.
onlyOwner modifier gates setBlackListBot against non-owner callers.
onlyOwner modifier gates setBlackAddress against non-owner callers.
onlyOwner modifier gates setFeeTotal, protecting the mint path.
onlyOwner modifier gates setMaxTxBlack.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership.
_msgSender() returns the untrusted caller address.
Caller address flows into the sender role of _transfer via transfer().
Untrusted caller indexes the allowance mapping being deducted.
Untrusted caller address receives the minted balance credit.
Untrusted caller supplies itself as spender to transferFrom.
Read of _balances[sender] before the SafeMath subtraction.
Write-back of the debited sender balance.
Read of _balances[recipient] before the SafeMath addition.
Write-back of the credited recipient balance.
Allowance mapping is read during the transferFrom deduction.
Allowance mapping is written by _approve.
_tTotal is read before being increased.
Increased supply is written back to _tTotal.
Existing _maxBlack is overwritten by an unchecked multiplication.
The overflow-prone product is stored into _maxBlack.
_tBotAddress participates in the max-amount branch of _transfer.
_tBlackAddress exempts senders from the max-amount branch of _transfer.
Stored _owner is compared against _msgSender in the onlyOwner modifier.
Untrusted caller is compared with _owner for privilege checks.
sender parameter drives the balance lookups in _transfer.
sender parameter is forwarded by transferFrom.
sender parameter indexes the debited balance slot.
recipient parameter drives the balance credit in _transfer.
recipient parameter is supplied by transfer.
recipient parameter indexes the credited balance slot.
amount parameter is subtracted from the sender balance.
amount parameter is added to the recipient balance.
spender parameter is passed from approve.
spender parameter is validated and stored by _approve.
owner parameter keys the allowance mapping in _approve.
owner parameter indexes the allowance storage write.
blackListAddress parameter is written to _tBotAddress by an owner-only setter.
blackAddress parameter is written to _tBlackAddress by an owner-only setter.
maxTxBlackPercent is the unchecked operand of the multiplication.
newOwner parameter is written to _owner after the zero-address check.
account parameter indexes _balances in balanceOf.
amount parameter drives the supply and balance increase in setFeeTotal.
amount parameter is added to _tTotal.
Constructor local msgSender holds _msgSender() before _owner assignment.

normalization_plan.reason: The sender argument only exists to index balances/allowances inside _transfer and transferFrom, so it folds into the transfer routine.
Recipient is only consumed by the balance credit inside _transfer.
Transfer amount has no independent meaning outside the balance debit/credit pair.
Spender is only validated and stored in the allowance mapping by _approve.
Owner argument is solely the key for the allowance storage write in _approve.
The address argument is immediately assigned to _tBotAddress by this owner-only setter.
The address argument is immediately assigned to _tBlackAddress by this owner-only setter.
The argument feeds directly into the unchecked multiplication, so it belongs to the unsafe arithmetic operation.
New owner argument is validated and then written into _owner.
Account argument is only a lookup key for the balance view.
Mint amount argument is only used to inflate supply and the caller balance.
Constructor-local temporary simply caches the caller before the initial owner and balance assignment.
